description_en: Retrieves a list of certificate files
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-certificates --project-id 10000 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --name xm_create_test --create-user 1107550004253538 --start-create-time 1730217600000 --end-create-time 1593877765000 --sort-by Id --order Asc --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCertificates

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the certificate file belongs
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，默认值为10，最大值100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh: 查询第几页，默认值为1表示第一页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The name of the certificate file. Fuzzy match by file name is supported
parameters.help_zh: 文件名称，基于此名称做模糊查询
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who created the certificate files
parameters.help_zh: 查询某个创建者ID所创建的文件列表
parameters.name: create_user

parameters.help_en: The time when the certificate file was created. You can call this operation to query the files that are created after the time. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh:
查询创建时间在该日期之后的文件。
单位：毫秒
parameters.name: start_create_time

parameters.help_en: The time when the certificate file was created. You can call this operation to query the files that are created before the time. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh:
查询创建时间在该日期之前的文件。
单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_create_time

parameters.help_en: The field used to sort the certificate files. Valid values: CreateTime Id Name Default value: Id
parameters.help_zh:
认证文件列表排序字段，支持名称、创建时间、文件ID排序
- CreateTime
- Id
- Name

默认值：Id
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The order in which you want to sort the certificate files. Valid values: Desc: descending order ASC: ascending order Default value: Asc
parameters.help_zh:
认证文件列表排序方向，枚举值：
● Desc表示倒序
● Asc表示正序
默认值：Asc
parameters.name: order
